instruction: Create local folders for CUSTOMERS and VENDORS in Thunderbird.

metadata.explanation: Task requires creating two local folders in Thunderbird (CUSTOMERS and VENDORS). Evaluator checks for both folder files and .msf metadata files. Same complexity as original task with different folder names.
metadata.verification: Verified evaluator checks for CUSTOMERS and VENDORS folders and their .msf files using regex patterns.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator uses correct approach: ls -R on Thunderbird Local Folders directory to check folder creation
Complete coverage: checks both required folders (CUSTOMERS and VENDORS)
Comprehensive verification: checks both folder files and .msf metadata files that Thunderbird creates
Correct data flow: get_cache_file retrieves ls output, check_list processes with regex patterns
Appropriate postconfig: ls command runs during evaluation to get fresh state
Regex patterns are functional but overly complex: patterns like '\bCUSTOMERS/?(?!\.msf)' use negative lookahead which works but is fragile
Patterns will likely match correctly in typical ls -R output showing both folder names and .msf files
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Simplify regex patterns to be more robust: instead of '\bCUSTOMERS/?(?!\.msf)', consider '\bCUSTOMERS\b(?!\.msf)' or '\bCUSTOMERS:?' to match folder markers
Alternative approach: use two simpler patterns per folder - one for the .msf file (current pattern works) and one for the folder name without .msf (e.g., '\bCUSTOMERS\s' or '\bCUSTOMERS:')
Consider edge cases in ls -R output format - test patterns against actual Thunderbird folder listing output to ensure robustness
